selection: One epoch per mode minimizing max across roles of mean SB-hRMSE/reference; tie mean then earliest epoch. Reference is existing train-only fixed prior; used only for normalization.
scope: Repeated-use inner development only; no outer validation/test forecasts for selection. No refit at this stage.
change: Add direct observation history context to native GRU; raw tokens contain observed log concentration, interval, elapsed-dose, delivered-dose, infusion rate, replicate count, route flags, signed-log time, log age. Exclude prediction, innovation, sensitivity from added path. Native backbone still uses its original innovation features. Same training, losses and initial population as previous study.
secondary_evaluation: Evaluate k=0,1,4 only at k=2-selected checkpoints; never select epoch by secondary k.
